en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Every oath not intended for the Sake of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the High, regarding a divorce or freeing a slave, so it is not with anything’.
en.sarwar: 13. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Safwan from ibn Muskan from al-Halabiy who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Any oath which is not for the sake of Allah, most High, in divorce or freeing slaves does not have any valid effect.’”
